verses.text: Blessed be di man wey no dey waka for di advice of di wicked, no dey stand for di path of sinners and no dey sit for di seat of scoffers,
but im joy dey for di law of di Lord. Im law na wetin e dey think about day and night.
E go be like tree wey dem plant by streams of water, wey dey give fruit for im season, wey im leaf no dey dry. Everything wey e do go prosper.
Di wicked no be so, but dem be like chaff wey wind dey blow go.
So di wicked no go fit stand for judgment, and sinners no go fit stand for di gathering of di righteous.
Because di Lord know di way of di righteous, but di way of di wicked go perish.
Why di nations dey rage and di peoples dey plan empty thing?
Di kings of di earth dey take stand, and di rulers dey plan together against di Lord and against im Anointed One, dey talk say,
“Make we break dem chains and throw dem ropes from us.”
Di one wey dey sit for heaven go laugh. Lord go laugh dem for scorn.
Den e go talk to dem for im anger and frighten dem for im fury, say,
“Still, I don set my King for my holy hill of Zion.”
I go tell di decree: di Lord talk to me say, “You be my pikin. Today I don become your papa.
Ask me, and I go give you di nations as your inheritance and di farthest parts of di earth as your own.
You go break dem with iron rod. You go smash dem to pieces like potter pot.”
So now, una kings, make una wise. Una judges of di earth, make una learn.
Serve di Lord with fear and rejoice with trembling.
Honor di Son with true heart, so dat e no go vex and una go perish for di way, because im anger go soon burn. Blessed be all dem wey run go am for protection.

chapters.title: A Psalm by David, when e run from Absalom im pikin.

verses.text: Lord, how dem don increase, dem wey dey trouble me! Plenty dey rise up against me.
Plenty dey talk about my soul say, “No help dey for am from God.” Selah.
But you, Lord, na shield you be round me, my glory and di one wey dey lift up my head.
I dey cry to di Lord with my voice, and e dey answer me from im holy hill. Selah.
I lie down and sleep. I wake up, because di Lord dey hold me up.
I no go fear tens of thousands of people wey don set dem self against me for every side.
Stand up, Lord! Save me, my God! Because you don strike all my enemies for di cheek bone. You don break di teeth of di wicked.
Salvation belong to di Lord. Make your blessing dey on your people. Selah.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. With string instruments. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. You don give me room when I dey for trouble. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
Una sons of men, how long una go turn my honor to shame? Una go love empty things and look for lies? Selah.
But know say di Lord don set apart di godly person for imself. Di Lord go hear when I call am.
Fear am and no sin. Search your own heart for your bed and keep quiet. Selah.
Offer di sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust for di Lord.
Plenty dey talk say, “Who go show us any good?” Lord, make di light of your face shine on us.
You don put gladness for my heart, more than when dem grain and dem new wine increase.
For peace I go lie down and sleep, because you alone, Lord, dey make me dey safe.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. For flutes. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Give ear to my words, Lord. Think about wetin I dey think.
Listen to di voice of my cry, my King and my God, because na you I dey pray to.
Lord, for morning you go hear my voice. For morning I go put my request before you and wait with hope.
Because you no be God wey enjoy wickedness. Evil no fit stay with you.
Di proud no go stand for your sight. You hate all wrongdoers.
You go destroy dem wey dey talk lies. Di Lord hate man wey dey kill and cheat.
But as for me, because of di plenty of your faithful love, I go enter your house. I go bow toward your holy temple with respect for you.
Lead me, Lord, for your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
Because no faithfulness dey for dem mouth. Dem heart na destruction. Dem throat na open grave. Dem dey flatter with dem tongue.
Hold dem guilty, God. Make dem fall by dem own plans. Throw dem out because of di plenty of dem wrongs, because dem don rebel against you.
But make all dem wey run go you for protection rejoice, make dem shout for joy always, because you dey defend dem. Make dem wey love your name dey happy for you too.
Because you dey bless di righteous. Lord, you dey cover am with favor like shield.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. On string instruments, on di eighth. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Lord, no correct me for your anger and no punish me for your fury.
Have mercy on me, Lord, because I don weak. Lord, heal me, because my bones dey troubled.
My soul dey for big pain too. Lord, how long?
Return, Lord. Save my soul. Save me because of your faithful love.
Because for death nobody dey remember you. For Sheol, who go thank you?
I don tire with my groaning. Every night I dey wet my bed. I dey soak my couch with my tears.
My eye dey waste away because of grief. E dey old because of all my enemies.
Leave me, all una wey dey do wrong, because di Lord don hear di voice of my crying.
Di Lord don hear my begging. Di Lord accept my prayer.
All my enemies go shame and dey troubled. Dem go turn back, dem go shame sudden sudden.

chapters.title: A meditation by David, wey e sing to di Lord, about di words of Cush, one Benjamite.

verses.text: Lord my God, I run go you for protection. Save me from all dem wey dey chase me and free me,
so dat dem no go tear my soul like lion, dey tear am to pieces, while nobody dey to save.
Lord my God, if I don do dis, if wrong dey my hands,
if I don pay evil back to am wey dey peace with me, yes, I don free di one wey be my enemy for no reason,
make di enemy chase my soul and catch am. Yes, make e step my life down to di ground and put my glory for dust. Selah.
Stand up, Lord, for your anger. Lift yourself up against di rage of my enemies. Wake up for me. You don appoint judgment.
Make di gathering of di peoples surround you. Rule over dem from high.
Di Lord dey judge di peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and to di honesty wey dey inside me.
Oh, make di wickedness of di wicked finish, but make di righteous strong, because di righteous God dey test hearts and minds.
My shield dey with God, wey dey save di honest for heart.
God na righteous judge, yes, God wey dey vex every day.
If man no repent, e go sharpen im sword. E don bend im bow and make am ready.
E don prepare di weapons of death for am too. E dey make im burning arrows ready.
Look, e dey suffer to give birth to wickedness. Yes, e don conceive trouble and born lie.
E don dig hole and don fall inside di pit wey e make.
Im trouble go return on im own head. Im violence go come down on di top of im own head.
I go thank di Lord according to im righteousness and sing praise to di name of di Lord Most High.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. On instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Lord, our Lord, how great your name dey for all di earth, you wey don set your glory above di heavens!
From di mouth of babies and small pikin you don set up strength, because of your enemies, so dat you go silence di enemy and di one wey wan take revenge.
When I consider your heavens, di work of your fingers, di moon and di stars wey you don set,
wetin be man, say you dey think about am? Wetin be di son of man, say you dey care for am?
Because you don make am small small lower than God and crown am with glory and honor.
You make am ruler over di works of your hands. You don put all things under im feet:
all sheep and oxen, yes, and di wild animals of di field,
di birds of di sky, di fish of di sea and anything wey dey pass inside di paths of di seas.
Lord, our Lord, how great your name dey for all di earth!

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Death of di Son. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: I go thank di Lord with all my heart. I go tell all your wonderful works.
I go dey glad and rejoice for you. I go sing praise to your name, you Most High.
When my enemies turn back, dem dey stumble and perish before you.
Because you don defend my right and my case. You sit for di throne dey judge with righteousness.
You don rebuke di nations. You don destroy di wicked. You don wipe out dem name forever and ever.
Endless ruin don catch di enemy. Even di memory of di cities wey you don overthrow don perish.
But di Lord dey rule forever. E don prepare im throne for judgment.
E go judge di world with righteousness. E go judge di peoples with fairness.
Di Lord go be stronghold for di oppressed too, stronghold for times of trouble.
Dem wey know your name go trust you, because you, Lord, no leave dem wey dey look for you.
Sing praises to di Lord, wey dey stay for Zion, and tell di people wetin e don do.
Because di one wey dey avenge blood dey remember dem. E no dey forget di cry of di suffering.
Have mercy on me, Lord. See my suffering from dem wey hate me, you wey dey lift me up from di gates of death,
so dat I go tell all your praises. For di gates of di daughter of Zion, I go rejoice for your salvation.
Di nations don sink inside di pit wey dem make. For di net wey dem hide, dem own foot don catch.
Di Lord don make imself known. E don do judgment. Di wicked don catch for di work of im own hands. Think about am. Selah.
Di wicked go return to Sheol, even all di nations wey forget God.
Because dem no go forget di needy forever, and di hope of di poor no go perish forever.
Stand up, Lord! No let man win. Make dem judge di nations for your sight.
Strike dem with terror, Lord. Make di nations know say dem na only men. Selah.
Why you dey stand far, Lord? Why you dey hide yourself for times of trouble?
For pride, di wicked dey hunt di weak. Make dem catch dem for di plans wey dem don plan.
Because di wicked dey boast about im heart desires. Di greedy man dey curse and reject di Lord.
Di wicked, for im proud face, no dey look for God. All im thoughts na say, “No God dey.”
Im ways dey prosper all di time. Your judgments dey high, out of im sight. As for all im enemies, e dey laugh dem.
E dey talk for im heart say, “Nothing go shake me. I no go ever dey for trouble.”
Im mouth full of curse, deceit and oppression. Under im tongue na trouble and wickedness.
E dey wait near di villages. From hiding place e dey kill di innocent. Im eyes dey secretly set against di helpless.
E dey hide for secret like lion for im den. E dey wait to catch di suffering. E dey catch di suffering when e pull am inside im net.
Di helpless dey crushed, bow down and fall by im strength.
E dey talk for im heart say, “God don forget. E don hide im face. E no go ever see am.”
Stand up, Lord! God, lift up your hand! No forget di suffering.
Why di wicked person dey condemn God and dey talk for im heart say, “You no go ask am to account”?
But you dey see trouble and grief, to take am into your hand. Di helpless dey commit dem self to you, because you be helper of di orphan.
Break di arm of di wicked. As for di evil man, look for im wickedness until you no find any.
Di Lord na King forever and ever. Di nations go perish from im land.
Lord, you don hear di desire of di humble. You go prepare dem heart. You go make your ear hear,
to judge di orphan and di oppressed, so dat man wey belong to di earth no go frighten people again.
